title: IN WHICH A CONVERSATION TAKES PLACE WHICH SEEMS LIKELY TO COST PHILEAS FOGG DEAR
summary_hover: At the Reform Club, Phileas Fogg discusses a recent bank robbery and accepts a twenty thousand pound wager to circle the globe in eighty days.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg arrives at the Reform Club and joins his whist partners, who are debating a recent fifty-five thousand pound theft from the Bank of England. The conversation turns to the size of the world and a newspaper estimate that it can be traversed in eighty days. Confident in his mathematical precision, Fogg accepts a wager of twenty thousand pounds to complete the journey himself, planning to leave that very evening.
